title: 10 Best Ligustrum Lucidum Preparations
intro: The best medicinal preparations of Ligustrum lucidum are decoctions, teas, tinctures, capsules, and syrups, each offering unique benefits for health. Decoctions involve boiling the dried berries to extract their medicinal properties, while teas are made by steeping the herb in hot water. Tinctures provide a concentrated form using alcohol, making them potent and easy to dose. Capsules offer a convenient and standardized option for daily use. Syrups are often used for their soothing effects and are particularly beneficial for respiratory and digestive ailments.
